title: NetHack Terminal Screensaver Implementation Plan
summary: Step-by-step implementation plan for a NetHack terminal screensaver: vendored AutoAscend port, config, game log, ANSI renderer, player loop, launcher, and zsh idle hook.
notes: Implementation plan, not a spec. Classed as SPEC because it carries technical contracts: Global Constraints, Interfaces blocks, config keys, state paths, and timing values (watchdog 60 s, idle 300 s). Could also be DOC.
